title: GitLab Label Description Uncontrolled Resource Consumption Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of GitLab. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of label descriptions. By sending a crafted request, an attacker can consume all available resources on the server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
